technical-summary: Implemented the AS16/SH07 validation gaps exposed by AS30 testing: added redacted request_runtime_status without starting SessionRuntime, single-request queue slot inspection, live session runtime status snapshots, cancel acknowledgement fields and first-writer semantics, service-root active-work records for dispatch claims, stale queued-claim release, stale running interruption with recovery acknowledgement, and active-work cleanup after terminal/recovery repair. Added hostile recovery tests for malformed active-work entries, missing request evidence retention, idempotent stale recovery, and concurrent cancel acknowledgement races.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway runtime status and recovery are now durable and hostile-tested: stale owners are repaired, cancellation acknowledgement is explicit, and runtime diagnostics stay redacted.
